items.question: What is happening?

items.text: Budgets, forecasts and scenario models that leadership can actually use.

items.text: Profitability by product, cost structure, pricing, collections and core financial processes.

items.text: Resource utilization, dashboards and metrics for better decisions, and project coordination across teams so recommendations actually get implemented.

decision.title: From analysis to decision
decision.text: Reports are not the goal. Every engagement ends with a clear recommendation: *this is what's happening, and this is what we should do.*

start.title: How we start and when you see first progress
items: **Weeks 1–4: Focused diagnostic.** Fixed scope and fixed price. You get a reading of your current numbers and a prioritized list of improvements.
**First 30 days after you decide to continue: First dashboard** in use by your team.
**Months 2–3: Forecast and recommendations** embedded in your regular management cycle.

ways.title: Ways of working and low risk
items: **Start small:** a focused diagnostic at a fixed price, with no commitment to continue.
ways.closing: You keep the models, dashboards and documentation we build together. Confidentiality agreement signed before we start.

connecta.title: How I work: the C.O.N.E.C.T.A. model
connecta.intro: The same sequence shows up in every project, regardless of industry or role.

steps.text: **Comprehend.** I understand how the business works before proposing anything: goals, flows and what information really matters.
**Observe.** I look for relationships between processes, data and people that explain why results look the way they do.
**Navigate complexity.** I bring fragmented information and competing views into one shared picture.
**Strategy.** I connect the analysis to business goals, so decisions are prioritized and aligned.
**Collaborate.** Sustainable change depends on people. I work through dialogue and agreement.
**Transform.** The goal is not a diagnosis but concrete improvement: clearer processes and stronger decisions.
**Add value.** I measure the impact so the value is visible, not assumed.

esg.text: **Complementary line: ESG and sustainability.** Theoretical grounding in sustainability reporting frameworks (including CSRD), applied as a complement to financial work.
